protocol: existing split portions keep their roles (gepa-1 -> taxonomy, eval-1 sample -> judging, eval-1 domain -> generalization); remaining sizes filled by a seeded draw from never-run tasks, stratified by label
purpose: master partition: every later study draws its tasks from inside one pool and nothing crosses pools
rule: pool sizes are ceilings; a study may use fewer tasks, always drawn from the pool made for its purpose; tasks the optimizer saw are only ever in the taxonomy pool
